purpose: Admin-facing canonical media metadata read model with Cloudflare custom-domain URLs and asset tags.
ownedRules: Response tags are normalized through AssetTagRules before serialization so UI consumers receive the same 40-character/16-tag contract as writes.
Each response represents one immutable canonical object; resized or format variants are never stored.
Asset responses expose backend-built custom-domain URLs and do not expose R2 endpoints or runtime static paths.
